answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fakes at the inlet. Each vertex posts a 50-token deposit for one slot, burned if its work fails audit, so one operator cannot hold many slots. Auditors sample work; a failed slot burns the deposit and bars re-entry for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 tokens, far above slot rewards. An honest agent pays 50 tokens and keeps full rewards, since fakes are priced out before they spiral into a majority.
